extension.summary: Smooth Prime: Prime Video in the Aurora Cinema interface
extension.description: Smooth Prime is maintained by AgreeWithScotty. Catalog, account authentication, HTTPS transport, media resources, Widevine license relay, subtitles and playback lifecycle use independently written implementations. The dedicated Aurora interface is adapted from Scott's SmoothFlix. Not affiliated with Amazon. See NOTICE.md for asset and dependency licenses.
extension.disclaimer: Uses your own Amazon account and Kodi InputStream Adaptive with Widevine. Not affiliated with Amazon.
extension.news: 0.2.50[CR]- Follow Amazon-declared Continue Watching continuations automatically, publishing each fresh batch without waiting for scrolling.[CR]- Keep TV containers when their previously watched episode is complete, and retain actively resumed re-watches.[CR]- Decode fractional progress and resume position; show played position, remaining time and the progress bar using returned metadata.[CR]- Show full-scene genre artwork immediately instead of plain Amazon category gradients; upgrade from already preloaded genre results without extra catalog fetches.[CR]- Record history batch counts, parser inventory, completion filtering and progress-field availability for actual-account diagnosis.
